protocol.name: high-resolution raw RGB patch refinement before peak-then-pose
protocol.dataset: 2012-02-18 validation development set; not an independent sequence test
protocol.baseline: SC2-PCR followed by two-stage full-pool refinement at 1.2 m and 0.6 m
protocol.correspondence_set: frozen train-map RoMa controlled validation cache
protocol.head: shared full-resolution RGB patch encoder; RoMa local similarity map and candidate validity are input channels; no confidence head
protocol.loss_training: continued high-resolution patch-head training; deployed SciPy L-BFGS-B forward with KKT implicit differentiation of the same bounded LiDAR-camera objective; final pose MPE/MOE loss plus weak normalized pixel supervision
protocol.pose_backend: same L-BFGS-B peak-then-pose objective, precision matrices, LiDAR prior and bounds for both visual methods
